name: xk-corporate-income-tax
description: Prepare Kosovo corporate income tax working papers for an ordinary company: distinguish real-income taxation from quarterly small-business payments, test the EUR 30000 threshold and election history, reconcile accounting profit to taxable income, track depreciation and carried losses, and prepare quarterly instalments and the annual settlement. Use for Kosovo company tax, corporate returns, real-income elections and quarterly advance-payment questions. Covers 2026 using Law 06/L-105, current tax-authority forms and the current tax-procedure statute. It includes ordinary assets, bad debts, donations, distributions and liquidation. Gross-interest reporting and the remaining implementing-rule questions are listed as not yet confirmed.
